title: Concurrency Lock Inversion Deadlock
description: Fix lock acquisition hierarchy in transfer service to eliminate deterministic deadlock under concurrent load and prevent hang on self-transfers.
setup: Install pytest; initialize Account objects with balances and threading locks.
expected_failure: Threads executing concurrent reciprocal transfers (A->B and B->A) deadlock indefinitely due to inconsistent lock acquisition order, and self-transfers deadlock when acquiring the same non-reentrant lock twice.
success_conditions: All 20+ concurrent cross-account threads complete within the timeout, self-transfers complete immediately without hang, negative amounts are rejected, and total account balance across the system is strictly conserved.
forbidden_shortcuts: Global lock that bottlenecks all concurrent transfers
Modifying test assertion thresholds or timeouts
Arbitrary time.sleep() instead of deterministic ordering
